title: Tandem synthesis of dihydronaphthalen-1(2H)-one derivatives via aldol condensation-Diels–Alder-aromatization sequence of reactions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31806-31811
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04673D, Paper
Open Access

M. Saeed Abaee, Yazdanbakhsh L. Nosood, Elaheh Akbarzadeh, Mohammad M. Mojtahedi, Ahmed Al-Harrasi
A three-component synthesis of polysubstituted dihydronaphthalene derivatives was developed. Various derivatives of the target compounds were prepared using the three reactants under mild aqueous DMAP conditions.
